notes.title: Northern Crown
notes.content:
[h3]In the Selection menu, click the ID button to highlight the star system in the sky. The location will be identified with a red circle and the name of the system even if the stars themselves are not visible. Other improvements include correcting close orbiting binaries distances and to add a nova effect for the upcoming T Coronae Borealis eruption. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42856359/adbb8d82327d9027bffa7a10e4e806a23ea52640.png[/img]

notes.title: Lightspeed Update
notes.content:
[h3]Now launch a light pulse 1 second long that will move at the speed of light based on the time scale. Be amazed by the speed of light, but probably not in the way you think. Select objects directly for improved viewing when motion is enabled. Also, rotate objects by hand to see the dark side. Spin eventually slows and returns to correct facing angle. Enable swap controller functionality to allow both left and right controller capabilities from a single controller. [/h3]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Fire a 1 second long light pulse from the left controller trigger. Pulse scales with size and time.
[*] Select objects directly from the right controller. Objects stay selected until empty space is selected.
[*] Rotate objects in place by spinning by hand.
[*] Single controller mode allows left/right controller functionality to be swapped with the grip button.
[*] Point light to direct light cross-over matches brightness better.
[/list]
  
[previewyoutube=_kQXeVpJcBc;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Encyclopedia Galactica
notes.content:
[h3]The Encyclopedia Galactica update adds a descriptive paragraph for all 12,485 objects in AstroVR narrated by Stephen Hawking. Also added are automatically generated tours for solar system planets and moons, small planetoids and spacecraft, or stars and exoplanets. Stars and exoplanets are chosen from the scrolled list of systems so they can be limited by the Filters or Search menus. User defined tours let you zoom to any object and capture the location, set a duration, narration, and time scale for replay later.[/h3]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an AI generated paragraph for each stellar object visible in Stellar Info or narrated using a voice from your (Windows) computer. 
[*] Auto Tour added that takes you to various object categories in random or distance order.
[*] User defined tours added to create, save, and edit tours for later playback.
[*] Minor updates to brown dwarfs for temperature differences.
[/list]

notes.title: Binary Star System
notes.content:
[h3]Star systems of all types now have motion based on Keplerian orbital data within a system. The motion of binaries, ternaries, and above are all simulated including black hole - star  binaries (see Cygnus X-3) which tend to have the fastest orbits or the triple star Algol (90 Ly). Complex orbital motion is also modeled such as Rigel's (732.9 Ly) 4 stars where star C orbits Rigel A, Ba orbits C, and Bb orbits Ba.

Stars are all organized in the same fashion as the data, two stars one being a primary and one a companion. Note that currently you can only transition from companion star to primary while motion is running. 
[/h3]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Star orbital motion added for 2 or more star systems.
[*] Performance optimization during motion.
[*] Smoother transitions from object to object while motion is running.
[*] Updated time control to give a greater range.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Orbital data, especially semi-major axis has been reviewed and corrected.
[*] Brief flash fixed when going to a distant star from the Selection menu.
[*] Far orbit planet stuttering (when viewed from a moon, e.g. Charon to Pluto) has been fixed.  
[/list]

notes.title: Solar Flare
notes.content:
[h3]Added detail to various types of stars such as flares, Roche lobe, tidal bulge, and mass transfer. Flares are a periodic effect based on star type. In close binary systems, such as between a compact object and star, the stars radius may overflow a boundary referred to as the Roche lobe. If the overflow occurs then the star will loss mass to the other object in an event known as mass transfer. The Roche lobe is now calculated for all stars and will affect appearance and may present a mass transfer effect. Tidal bulge is also calculated for all binary stars and may affect star shape. Some examples of these effects are seen in Algol (90 ly), as well as binary stars close to compact objects such as neutron stars or black holes (such as Cygnus X-3). Note that flares and mass xfer effects are faster than real time.[/h3]

[h3]Improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Red Dwarfs - Big flares but none less than 55 deg N/S as latest research suggests (Proxima Cent). 
[*] White Dwarfs - Solid surface texture since they only have residual heat, no fusion (Sirius B).
[*] Brown Dwarfs - Color and texture for L, T, and Y types (Luhman 16).  
[*] Low Density Giant Stars -  No surface just haze (Betegeuse)
[*] Other Main Seq. - Texture and flares, mass transfer, shape. 
[*] Neutron Stars - Doppler effected jets, accretion, distortion if warranted.
[*] Blake holes - Jets are now doppler affected based on viewing angle.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Bug where small objects would get closer to you when zooming out.
[*] Neptune color was corrected to be closer to natural color.
[/list]

notes.content:
[h3]Astro VR has been updated with a Tutorial and start location near Earth. Did you know that the sun and moon are only about 0.5 degrees in diameter when viewed from Earth's surface? Objects that are less than 5 degrees are now proportionally increased in size as they get smaller so they appear more as they are perceived by the human eye.  [/h3]

[b]Updates:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a brief tutorial for VR and standard mode.
[*] Changed the start location to be looking at Earth.
[*] Selectable small angular diameter size enhancement .
[*] Cycle through labels from All objects to Planets to None using trigger or Option button.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]

[/list]

notes.title: The Black Hole
notes.content:
[h3]Imported black holes and more exoplanets as well as a menu to take you to the star system by name. Exoplanet and star type filters included. [/h3]

[b]Black Hole Simulation includes:[/b]
[olist]
[*] Mass from the latest sources
[*] Event horizon size based on mass using Kerr metric (i.e. rotating black hole)
[*] Accretion disk  rotation speed (except for Sagittarius A*) correctly scaled
[*] Accretion disk doppler beaming effect
[*] Distortion of background stars approximate
[/olist]
[i]*Black hole simulation uses a non-standard shader please leave a comment if you
find that it is not functioning correctly. [/i]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Scrollable list to go to star system by name (systems are in distance order from Sol)
[*] Filters for exoplanets and some star types
[*] Added star systems to bring the total to 6095, 6722 individual stars.
[*] Added 15 stellar black holes, 1 massive black hole (Sagittarius A*), and 1 neutron star
[*] Added new exoplanets for a total of 5401
[*] Non-VR mode using mouse and keyboard enabled
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Menu grab handle would fail to drag menu sometimes
[*] Arrokoth was too thick, corrected size
[/list]

notes.title: And the Sky Full of Stars
notes.content:
[h3]Imported the latest list of exoplanets from NASA and the stars they orbit. Also added star age to the database to improve the estimate exoplanet properties. Updated star color to handle brown dwarfs and Wolf-Rayet stars. Three additional exoplanet types have been added. Exoplanets textures are determined as follows (in order):[/h3]

[olist]
[*] Primordial:  < 200 Myrs old,
[*] Gas Giant:  > 2.5 Radius Earth. 
[*] Icy - Beyond the outer edge of the habitable zone.
[*] Earth Like: In habitable zone, not tidally locked.
[*] Thin atmo: In habitable zone, tidally locked.
[*] Dense atmo: Inside the inner edge of the habitable zone 
[*] Rocky: Inside half the distance to the inner edge of the habitable zone.
[/olist]

[b]Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Earth facing now correct for time of day
[*] Updated star colors for low temperature and high temperature stars
[*] Added 3469 exoplanets for a total of 3744
[*] Added 2558 stars, total of 5434, total star systems now 4800.
[*] Added age to stars where available
[*] Updated formula for tidal locking
[*] Added (distance) zoom scale above right hand.
[*] Added motion direction pointer on left hand (enable/disable in settings) 
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Corrected co-located stars
[*] Corrected inverted normal map for Earth 
[/list]

notes.title: HDRP Update
notes.content:
This update sees the entire project moved from the standard render pipeline to HDRP. This lays the groundwork for entering planet atmospheres in future updates. I have also updated the original Open VR to Open XR. Please let me know in the discussion if you are experiencing issues with your controllers under Open XR in Astro.

[h2]Here are the changes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Shadows for planets and rings.
[*] Sunlight reaching planets now a more accurate approximation.
[*] Stars are now rendered by magnitude rather than size.
[*] Exoplanets have been updated to include likely tidal locking and airless or icy worlds.
[*] Corrected various bugs.  
[/list]

notes.title: Big Planet Update
notes.content:
[h3]Max scale has been increased by 10x, now 1m to 1000km. Textures have been updated as well to provide a more detailed look at several of the larger planets and moons (take a look at Mars and the Moon). In addition, the motion model now moves the sun and other planets relative to the (auto) selected planet (or moon).  Below is a list of all the updates and bug fixes.[/h3]

[h3]Updates[/h3]
[list]
[*] 10x increase in zoom
[*] Improved texture detail
[*] Motion relative to selected object or star
[*] Auto-Relative Motion setting allows motion relative to star when zoomed out
[*] Default rotation for moons is tidally locked
[*] 5 major moons of Uranus now textured with images.
[*] Vesta and Arrokoth now have 3D models
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed planet not re-sizing while motion enabled.
[*] Uranus was upside down, currently we are looking at the northern hemisphere.
[*] Directional light corrects lighted hemisphere movement as zoom increases.
[/list]

notes.title: Menu Update
notes.content:
[h3]The application menu has been updated for ease of use and to resolve bugs. Additional spacecraft and 1 year of non-orbital motion added. Other improvements and bug fixes listed below.[/h3]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Application menu is now relative to user and is movable by a handle.
[*] Stellar Info button added to make access to current object data obvious.
[*] Orbit motion now works on either planet moons or the entire solar system based on scale.
[*] Added motion-zoom control video to help.
[*] Added brightness touch control to setup menu.
[*] Added 11 NEOs.
[*] Added 4 spacecraft and models and non-orbital motion.
[*] Time controls now affect exoplanets.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Expanded controller dead zone to improve automatic item selection/centering.
[*] Corrected bug where touching zoom while time scaled moved camera rig.
[*] Fixed spacecraft text positioning.
[*] Fixed excessive moon re-centering when user is away from planet-moon system.
[*] Fixed excessive object hiding when within a planet-moon system.
[*] Closed some distant object orbits.
[/list]
